paper_title: Light Dark Matter Search with Ionization Signals in XENON1T
notes: XENON1T S2-only ionization search for light DM. Constrains absorption of dark photons (kinetic mixing kappa, panel F) and ALPs (g_ae, panel E) over mass range 0.186-1 keV. Only one explicit numerical dark photon point given in Table I: m_chi=0.5 keV/c^2 (500 eV), kappa=2.2e-16 at 90% CL. The full exclusion curve in Fig.5F is not numerically tabulated. Note the paper also reports an ALP limit (g_ae=7.7e-14 at 500 eV) which would be AxionElectron; chose DarkPhoton per hint and primary tabulated value. DM density not explicitly stated. | Vision: The supplied calibration (3-35 GeV, 1e-46 to 1e-40) corresponds to panel A (SI DM-nucleus), not the dark photon panel. The DarkPhoton limit is in Figure 5 panel (F) with x = m_chi in keV/c2 (0.2-5 keV) and right y-axis kinetic mixing kappa (1e-16 to 1e-13). Anchored to Table I: kappa=2.2e-16 at 500 eV. Boundary traced from the black XENON1T (this work) curve; lower region is allowed, above is excluded. | Calibration: No calibration needed
